description: This file provides a utility class for managing test sharding configurations, reading JSON configuration files, and determining test allocation across shards for a specific platform.

classes.name: ShardingTestConfig
classes.description: Encapsulates sharding configuration logic for test distribution.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes sharding configuration, reads config file if not provided, and creates default shard.

methods.name: _read_platform_sharding_config
methods.description: Reads sharding configuration JSON for a specific platform.

methods.name: _find_unmapped_test_chunks
methods.description: Identifies test chunks that are not yet assigned in the current sharding configuration.

methods.name: _create_default_shard
methods.description: Creates the default test shard including all unmapped tests and chunks.

methods.name: get_test_run_config
methods.description: Determines if a test runs in a specific shard and returns its configuration.
